findings.evidence: If you provide us with your postal or e-mail address or telephone number, this information will only be used for the purpose for which you provided it, such as to: Provide you with the publications or information requested; Clarify your order or request; Register you for a user account, conference or other event; Respond to you regarding your job application; Provide you with related information; or Send you a token of appreciation through postal mail if you participate in selected online activities.
findings.rationale: The policy explicitly denies the collection of personally identifiable information for analytics purposes.
